# Documentation Task

Report missing, stale, or unclear documentation.

Suggested title prefix: `docs: ` — Label: `documentation`

## Documentation Target

Name the document, generated artifact, API docs, or code docs. (Required)

## Gap

Describe what is missing, stale, incorrect, or unclear. (Required)

## Audience

Name who depends on this documentation. (Required)

## Proposed Change

Describe the documentation change. (Required)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ... (Required)

## Validation Plan

Name the exact command, link check, review, or manual follow-through. (Required)

## Evidence

Add source files, current behavior, screenshots, logs, or examples. (Optional)

## Risks

Note reader confusion, migration, compatibility, or rollout risks. (Optional)
